_note: The single good-citizen policy for the Investify client. Every ceiling below is set by the OWNER, not by Investify: daily_ceiling 12 and weekly_ceiling 60 are the owner's own limits. Defaults: every collector OFF. Limits can be made stricter here; the code refuses any value outside its floors and fails closed on an unreadable file.

friday_break_pkt._note: Official Jumma break (no trading), PKT. Must agree with the Friday gap in config/psx_calendar.json open_sessions (tested).
